content.name: Simple Strings
content.description:
zscoder 喜欢简单串！如果一个字符串 $t$ 的任意相邻两个字符都不相同，则称其为简单串。例如，ab、aba、zscoder 都是简单串，而 aa、add 都不是简单串。

现在 zscoder 有一个字符串 $s$。他想最少地修改字符，使得字符串 $s$ 变为简单串。请帮助他完成这个任务！
content.formatI: 仅一行，包含字符串 $s$（$1 \leq |s| \leq 2 \cdot 10^{5}$）——这是 zscoder 给出的字符串。字符串 $s$ 只包含小写英文字母。
content.formatO:
输出一个简单串 $s'$ —— 这是对字符串 $s$ 经过最少修改后的结果。如果存在多种方案，你可以输出其中任意一种。

注意，输出的字符串 $s'$ 也只能包含小写英文字母。

en.name: Simple Strings
en.description:
zscoder loves simple strings! A string $ t $ is called simple if every pair of adjacent characters are distinct. For example ab, aba, zscoder are simple whereas aa, add are not simple.

zscoder is given a string $ s $ . He wants to change a minimum number of characters so that the string $ s $ becomes simple. Help him with this task!
en.formatI: The only line contains the string $ s $ ( $ 1<=|s|<=2·10^{5} $ ) — the string given to zscoder. The string $ s $ consists of only lowercase English letters.
en.formatO:
Print the simple string $ s' $ — the string $ s $ after the minimal number of changes. If there are multiple solutions, you may output any of them.

Note that the string $ s' $ should also consist of only lowercase English letters.
